comment_regular: Verified generic TESFile GameSettingCollection value loader. On a DATA chunk it branches by the registered setting's type; string-valued settings are read and passed to Setting_SetStringValue. This proves named settings can be updated through the generic file-record path, not that a blood-particle effect selects Extra1/Extra2.
